channel.title: Torchfinder -- reese.biz
channel.description: Content lookup for Shadowdark. Find adventures, supplements, and zines.

item.title: The Devil is in The Details
item.description: In this one-shot, the members of the party hail from one or more family farms in Boreton. Furthermore, they shall each roleplay as the uniquely mediocre Roustabout class created by Michael Putlack (Night Noon Games) and Kelsey Dionne (The Arcane Library). The party must defend their land against the consequences of a deal with a devil: a magical varmint that might just unravel the secrets held by local farmers.
item.dc:creator: Arthur Marques

item.title: The Diabolical Lair of Professor Memnon
item.description: After one man segues from the aristocratic high life to evil experimentation in a secluded 16-room hideaway, weird goings-on in a nearby town put the party on his trail. 1st- to 3rd-level characters must defeat the pulp-incarnate Professor Memnon and his henchmen (stat blocks included). Provides tables for generating a custom "Supervillain Sanctuary." Includes VTT-amenable tokens and a map.
item.dc:creator: Ogre College

item.title: The Embrace of Cinder's End
item.description: "Tentacles in my Shadowdark? It's more likely than you think." As the inexhaustible tentacles burst through the brickwork of this eight-page adventure, players may explore the lore of Susurrus with a new class and lineage. Can they survive the fear-inducing three-floor dungeon where it all happens, let alone stop the Embrace?
item.dc:creator: Invisible Cuts

item.title: The Hand of Ca'Lutra
item.description: When the empress Ca'Lutra comes to town, her left hand flings hordes of undead upon its denizens with the utmost disregard for their emotional well-being. Will the adventurers, who just so happened to be strolling by during this calamity, save the day?
item.dc:creator: abresch

item.title: The Last Waltz
item.description: The party's patron tells of a wraith spinning and swaying along the unlit halls of an icicle-bearded manor enveloped in a shroud of deciduous growth. But the grand ball has yet to come to pass. How will the wraith take the characters' attempt to abscond with the riches piled there for just such an event in this 0th-level gauntlet?
item.dc:creator: a hobgoblin

item.title: The Mad Goddess
item.description: Multiplying Grublids and manipulative Cubi, venturing further and further from the rekindled halls of a reawakened goddess' cobwebbed keep, have increasingly distressed the locals. Can a party of four 2nd- to 3rd-level characters take on these foes within their snake-filled halls, stopping Goddess Sensa's hunger for domination?
item.dc:creator: Daniel James

item.title: The Nightmare City of Dr. Satan
item.description: During rest, a party of 4th- to 6th-level characters are teleported to the realm of Dr. Satan. In liminal Legba, a mazelike prison city, they must confront the fruits of unnatural experiments. Will they dispatch their abductor and his minions, returning to their former realm with loot in hand?
item.dc:creator: BogBaronLimited

item.title: The Swine of Aeaea
item.description: Will the village of Poe's Lantern be swallowed by the Aeaean Swamp encircling it? With around ten chambers in this dungeon adventure, characters at a minimum of 3rd-level will be tested by a reemerging demi-god. Could her witchy ways have something to do with the missing sailors, so the rumors say?
item.dc:creator: BorisUndead

item.title: The Swine of Aeaea
item.description: When newlyweds on a honeymoon retreat on the island of Aeaea disappear, its past unravels for the proprietor in charge. To keep the reputation of his business intact, he's hired the party to lead the search in this single-session pointcrawl. Designed for existing campaigns and one-shots. The five-chamber dungeon, found through querying several inhabitants of the isle, will clue the characters in on the alchemist who once polymorphed her company into boars for the mildest of transgressions. They could come away with up to two interesting items.
item.dc:creator: Chris Saunders, Carson Brown

item.title: The Undying Maiden - Free Edition
item.description: A multi-floor dungeon adventure set in the Towerfall ruins. Can the party end the suffering of the Undying Maiden who haunts its grounds, doomed to die horribly once a month? Includes a new monster, treasure, and a color-coded map. This free edition is eight pages. The paid expansion of the same name refines it to sixteen, augmenting the depth and breadth with additional features.
item.dc:creator: Leviathanapsu

item.title: The Undying Maiden - Expanded Edition
item.description: A multi-floor dungeon adventure set in the Towerfall ruins. Jam-packed with new gear and adaptive loot, magic items, and two new classes for any level. Will the party succumb to one of a hundred horrible deaths as provided in a special table (like the others who have set foot in the accursed fort)? Can they end the suffering of the Undying Maiden who haunts the grounds? Includes two new monsters and variations of the established bestiary, four new spells, and a background table. This expanded edition refines the free adventure of the same name, augmenting its depth and breadth from eight to sixteen pages.
item.dc:creator: Leviathanapsu

item.title: The Weald of the Whispering Water
item.description: Will the party emerge from the fog of a mosquito-infested swamp ravaged by a dwarven mining crew? Three to four 3rd- to 4th-level characters would do well to watch for snakes and avoid tripping over a mud-slathered stone, to say nothing of minding their torches. What awaits them are disembodied murmurs and other inexplicable sounds and sensations creeping in the periphery.
item.dc:creator: Ian Dunn (id)

item.title: Three's a Crowd
item.description: Activation of the relic at the heart of this adventure means that either 1) the GM did not telegraph its destructive potential sufficiently, or 2) at least one of the players is a complete psychopath and needs to leave. Perhaps both. Regardless, bringing Persephone home without making all living beings in a 1d12-mile radius succeed a very difficult CON check is ideal. Lord Brygsworth is distraught over his missing adopted daughter, after all. You wouldn't disappoint him, would you?
item.dc:creator: Cameron Maas

item.title: Under The Inn
item.description: An isolated inn of ill-repute harbors secrets even worse than rumors would suggest. From interconnected tunnels below, worshippers of the abyssal demon king Dagon prey upon the patrons within, dragging them through the cellar and to a subterranean lake. Offers three different hooks to account for varying party circumstances.
item.dc:creator: Alexander Thegrin

item.title: Vengeance from the Sunken City
item.description: Jewels and the inner workings of "volcano-mechanical" steamworks await those who might venture to the part-submerged city-state of Lanteii to find the Queen's daughter. It hasn't been quite the same since an eruption devastated the enslaved population, replacing sorcerer-king Malachar's relentless and unfeeling reign of antipathy with misleading silence.
item.dc:creator: Connor McCloskey

item.title: Voyage Aboard the Flying Leopard
item.description: A murder mystery on a ship stocked with forbidden freight. If the peculiar souls aboard didn't confuse matters enough, the situation at sea fluctuates day by day, complicating the party's investigation. And just when they think they've got everything figured out, another headache will arise. If they make it off the ship alive, there are one of two new magic items that could be theirs. That is, if they can even carry one in particular. Includes respective GM and player maps.
item.dc:creator: Brynjar Már Pálsson

item.title: Weird West: The Alien Hideaway
item.description: A 3rd-level Wild West adventure into the isometric den of an alien-worshipping cult, featuring a legendary pistol to try out in the included gun duel minigame. With thematically illustrated pages, numerous NPCs quirky as can be, and frontier-flavored gear, this is a dungeon crawl that will surely please GMs and players alike with its time-bending personality.
item.dc:creator: Orion's Scriptorium

item.title: Roustabout
item.description: A class supplement featuring the most average of the average of classes: an abysmally mediocre caricature of peasantry who should've stayed in bed. With the Roustabout, even you can play a character whose martial prowess and wit make trimming shrubbery a life-or-death situation.
item.dc:creator: Michael Putlack, Kelsey Dionne

item.title: The Coming of the Unnamable Trinity
item.description: As the sky suddenly blackens, three baleful entities unleash a Mephistophelian horde at a rate determined by a "Conquest Roll mechanic" in either Viconis or a city of your choice. While this adventure can be dropped into any campaign, it's uniquely suited to campaign openers and one-shots, providing guidance for any of these scenarios. The only required material is the free 'Shadowdark RPG Quickstart Set.'
item.dc:creator: Kristof

item.title: A Very Merry Shadowe'en
item.description: Beholden to squabbling hags, the Island of Hands hauls itself each equinox with multitudes of spindly limbs across the dark. Each hag masquerades as an innocent maiden. When the island's grasping phalanges pluck the party, placing them in a fog-choked wood at its crown, they must circumvent being remade by the crones' rituals.
item.dc:creator: A. Denbigh Strickland

item.title: Ascension of the Serpent Queen
item.description: To find a prince whose caravan had been ambushed on the way to a diplomatic summit, the party must venture forth into the den of a fanatical cabal and their serpent queen. Survival depends upon slipping past traps and lurking horrors with time to spare for preventing an unspeakable ritual. 1st-level characters must stop the queen from further empowering herself in this adventure that includes tokens and portrait art.
item.dc:creator: Jay Rutley

item.title: Caverns of Carnage
item.description: Grimhaven and its subterranean tunnels have set the greedy in motion, yet the jungles are stalked by carving "cultists, cannibals, and a ravenous giant panther." Hooded zealots draped in feather-and-bone jewelry studded with gemstone chips (worth prying from a corpse) stand between 1st- to 3rd-level adventurers and far greater treasures.
item.dc:creator: Scott Swalwell

item.title: Choice of Life
item.description: Opportunity arises for 3rd- to 4th-level characters when the daughter of a werewolf family ferries them through a portal to the far side of the moon... but later betrays her own kin. The fleaborn are now intent on flushing the bloodline out from their peaceful existence in Hothers Valley. Features new monsters such as the "Worm that Walks," a new class, and magical gear.
item.dc:creator: Erik Frankhouse

item.title: Dacian Draco
item.description: Splicing wolves with dragons means a sojourn to the moon, where no torch nor magic will hold sway over the shadows. There are whispers that the Wolf Cult has returned in the accompanying 16-page A5 booklet, detailing a dungeon, compact adventuring area, and a new class called the Lone Wolf.
item.dc:creator: Mal Star

item.title: Detour to the City of Torment
item.description: Welcome to Torment, a city betwixt life and death at the liminal periphery of Chronospace, its gnarled and knotted streets crossing dimensions, and their myriad sub-dimensional layers, to the most twisted eldritch beings in the Kosmos. Sheer bravery or madness is the only necessary qualification for those wishing to participate in this sandbox adventure.
item.dc:creator: Fevery Beastcraft

item.title: Enigma of the Eryx Estate
item.description: 1st- to 3rd-level characters must solve a murder mystery of layered and experience-rewarding sub-mysteries by the hush of night. Otherwise, it might be the end of the party. A minimal-prep scenario set in a reclaimed roadside inn that once belonged to the Eryx family. Can the party help merchant Robert E. Wardlove save his distressed daughter?
item.dc:creator: Pakkanen

item.title: Eternal Fate in the Penthouse
item.description: The faint aroma of cinnamon wafts through a corrupted manor where an agent of seduction, generated with a convenient table, has lured a confidant to the party. Will they rescue their ally, or lose themselves in the deep yellow fog that curls through the sinuous halls?
item.dc:creator: LaffRaff

item.title: Gristle & Vine: The Tomb of ...
item.description: "Beware the gargoyles" warns the archivist, just after submitting a proposal to the party. In exchange for razing the remnants of the Lost Ones at a fresh dig site led by Jinjer Potts, there will be wealth beyond imagining in this one-shot.
item.dc:creator: Nick Campbell

item.title: House of the Candle Maker
item.description: Is there truth to the whispers that an apparition haunts the halls of the boarded-up mansion of the late Gray B'Moth, candlemaker and enigma? And what secrets might his candles still hold? Where is his fortune hidden within?
item.dc:creator: AngelsDidSay

item.title: Isle of the Evil Eye
item.description: After a sea-ringed garrison for viperians was stricken by a conniving devil, its former leader Sesnu has been remade in the form of a serpent. He loyally slithers along the halls, guarding riches and his master in this 1st- to 4th-level adventure.
item.dc:creator: Itch_Rokas

item.title: Lord of Discord
item.description: A 3rd-level hexcrawl in which the party must go to the isle of Skelda to hush a melody. Otherwise, it will lure more unsuspecting souls into the Lord of Discord's unbeatable test to find his successor. Sent by the King's Council to end this annual madness, the party must acquire four songs of the ancient Sea Elves to unlock a warded entryway to the Lord's domain.
item.dc:creator: Anzelak

item.title: Marrow
item.description: A retro-future descent into the undersea kingdom of Unlantis where a dormant wreck of a bio-machine notably contains untapped "marrow" fluid. The party, preferably four to six 3rd-level characters, must extract as much as possible before the "Vengeance" stirs back to life. Based on "Vengeance in Her Bones" by Malcolm Jameson.
item.dc:creator: Meaghan J

item.title: Sunfall over Swept Sands
item.description: An isolated town offers reprieve from the gargoyles swooping over the shifting sands of this compact hexcrawl. At least, it did until the bridge to it collapsed. Can the party help the stranded merchants and travellers? There are fourteen points of interest to captivate players, along with hand-illustrated maps specifically for them and the GM.
item.dc:creator: Fireside Tales

item.title: Temple of The Feathered Serpent
item.description: Stylized and inspired by Mesoamerica and its vibrant frescos, this adventure features a ziggurat that grinds out of the sands upon an astronomical conjunction that only occurs once per 55 years. The party must deal with competing treasure hunters and the Black Jaguar that lurks within the trapped interior if they want to recover the Double Chalice, a relic for reversing death. Well, if the undead manifestation of Quetzalcoatl lets them.
item.dc:creator: Aeo-winkler

item.title: The Awful AMBER DOOM
item.description: An ode to the old school in which the City Beneath the Sea upraises out of its oceanic entombment during a once-in-a-century lunar solstice. 3rd-level adventurers must race along coral-enshrouded mazes of driftwood, crawling with homunculytes and other fiends, to stop the Corpse-Master before he augments his power by an order of magnitude. Includes the whip-wielding Explorer class.
item.dc:creator: Reverse Ettin Games

item.title: The Chimera's Gift
item.description: Minds surrendered to the sweltering humidity of an island jungle, a cult of naturalists seal themselves within a temple, honing their ingenuity in a shared fever dream. 2nd- to 3rd-level characters breach the structure, discovering the products of prolonged, unmitigated derangement. There are treasures to come away with, including a new magic item, but only if the party can maintain their own sanity through this 31-room dungeon accompanied by seven precision-engineered monsters.
item.dc:creator: David Northcutt

item.title: Corruption at the Verdant Shrine
item.description: A bearded devil torments scattered humanoid camps near the site of a shrine it had seized in the woods, hunting for a warded magic relic that it would claim as its own... should the party fail to intervene. For three to five 2nd- to 3rd-level characters, this mini-dungeon runs roughly 4-6 hours.
item.dc:creator: ExHalibut

item.title: The Cold Red
item.description: Extreme weather in adventure setting form, with rules for the cold, the heat, and the accumulating stress that goes along with it. "Imagine the Australian outback but with blizzards, droughts and dragons." Features unique equipment, backgrounds, and monsters. The party can (and should) explore camp talents and stress-reduction activities during rest.
item.dc:creator: Mark Gosbell

item.title: Carousing with the Gnome King's Jewels
item.description: After twenty-five years of gossip, there is finally a lead on who stole the crown jewels from the gnome king. Where will the clue lead the party?
item.dc:creator: Dead Elf Press

item.title: Character Creation Guide
item.description: A quick reference for creating 0th- and 1st-level characters that distills ancestries, classes, weapons, armor, alignments, deities, backgrounds, languages, spells, and gear on two pages.
item.dc:creator: Ardefact

item.title: Cold Nights
item.description: A supplement that makes the frozen north playable in full. Introduces the Wilder, a class that survives brutal terrain by forging connections with local spirits and beasts. Rounds out the setting with arctic-specific weapons, armor, travel mechanics, cold weather effects, terrain types, gear, and stat blocks for northern creatures and mounts.
item.dc:creator: Marc-Antoine Côté

item.title: Cricket Creek Hollow
item.description: Long ago The Wild Wood swallowed the Belirian Empire; the land is now a reclaimed wilderness of scattered ruins. The village of Cricket Creek Hollow is the last inhabited place in the region, hosting a lore-laden hexcrawl with four new monsters, a name generator, and a treasure tournament.
item.dc:creator: Hollow Press

item.title: Drifter (Ranger) Class
item.description: A wilds-focused class for those who like to play beast-attuned trackers, solitary survivalists, and dual-wielding skirmishers. Enables a Drizzt-inspired character concept without destabilizing the table.
item.dc:creator: Christopher Wade (moatt)

item.title: Dusk till Dawnbarrow
item.description: A single-page introductory gauntlet set in an ancient barrow of a strange order. Designed for quick preparation and play.
item.dc:creator: Sentaijin

item.title: Escaping Bansunin
item.description: A 0th-level gauntlet set in lightless underground captivity. Characters are forced laborers in a subterranean camp and fed only what their captors deem expendable. Getting out alive is the only objective, and most won't. The author's debut adventure.
item.dc:creator: Nick Campbell (Cri)

item.title: Fey and Druid Essentials
item.description: Eight pages of fey and druid content: five fey ancestries, a druid class with six new spells, and three fey monsters. Essentials only; expanded in The Guide to the Fey and Fey Druids.
item.dc:creator: Jesse E. Olsen

item.title: Gnolls! Gnolls! Gnolls!
item.description: A free gnoll supplement detailing ancestry, backgrounds, lore, bestiary, "demonic gnolls" with special attacks, and tables galore.
item.dc:creator: Brian Coughlin

item.title: Grimdark Options
item.description: A foreboding rules supplement, adding three new classes: Plague Doctor, Witch Hunter, and Chaos Sorcerer. Introduces firearms and explosives alongside rules for the corrupting repercussions of evil magic.
item.dc:creator: Lost Heretic Press

item.title: Histories of the Planes
item.description: A supplement in which other planes mirror the "Home Plane," detailing extraplanar mechanics, traversal, and their connections to magic, space, and time. Includes random plane generation tables.
item.dc:creator: Keith Spears

item.title: Into the Halls of Havoc
item.description: A tomb for 3rd- to 4th-level characters to explore in which the warrior Havoc was sealed alongside his legendary sword: Ravager. Recovering it means cutting through wave after wave of undead while solving a dungeon-spanning puzzle.
item.dc:creator: Black Magician
